document.about: Ready Iowa emergency supply kit checklist, 2 pages, made in Canva. Page 1 sets rows of round photo icons, four or three to a row, a label of one to three lines under each, a heading set sideways beside each group of rows.

checks.issue: The labels' lines were read row by row across the icons: `Pet food and`, `AM/FM radio`, `supplies`; `Weather`, `Sleeping bag`, `appropriate`, `or blankets`, `clothing`.
As above: the row's labels read left to right.
checks.text: Small tools Sleeping bag or blankets Weather appropriate clothing Chargers and charging cables
